content:
Asha: Quick QBR kickoff for HorizonPay — target next Tue. Need slides + runbook. Onboarding 80% but two live blockers: SAML SSO cert rotation and batch CSV ingest failures. Renewal signal: amber. Can we map owners and exec asks?
Liam: I'm aligned. I'll own renewal economics slide. Can someone take SSO status? @Ravi? :eyes:
Ravi: Happy to take SSO. Will sync with infra tomorrow. ETA EOD Thu for clear remediation plan.
Jenna: From customer side — they're prioritizing SSO but want a test window before the dry run. Also asked for a short playbook for support handoff.
Olivia: I'll draft the playbook checklist. Will include rollback steps + contact matrix.
Asha: Nice. High-level exec asks we should prep: 1) commitment ask (seat growth + timeline), 2) fallback if SSO extends past renewal, 3) cost/usage trend explanation. Keep each slide 1-2 bullets.
Ravi: For SSO root cause: looking at cert rotation race condition in our staging deploy. Repro steps + logs in the doc. Will propose short-term patch and postmortem plan.
Liam: For renewal ask: propose 6-mo discount tied to milestone (SSO + batch stability). I'll draft language.
Asha: Dry run options: Fri 11am PT or Mon 9am PT. Which works?
Jenna: Fri 11am PT works for their execs. Prefer earlier to have adjustments.
Olivia: I'll have playbook draft by Thu noon and will paste into slides doc.
qbr-bot: New doc created: https://docs.internal/redwood/qbr/horizonpay-1763967890 (owners doc + slide canvas)
Asha: Action list (short):
- Ravi: SSO remediation plan + logs into doc — due Thu EOD
- Olivia: Support playbook checklist into slide deck — due Thu noon
- Liam: Renewal ask wording + economics slide — due Thu EOD
- Jenna: Confirm exec attendees + one-pager expectations — due Wed EOD
- Asha: Runbook + slide assembly + run dry run Fri 11am PT
Liam: I'll also add usage charts and token burn trend. Need last 90d export from billing. @Finance ping?
Jenna: We'll lock attendees today. Also collecting any demo flow gaps — I'll add two demo clips we must prep.
Ravi: Quick tech note: batch CSV failures appear to be hitting a 2MB line-length edge case. Patch PR in progress. If merged, we can propose a canary by Thu night.
Olivia: For the playbook, will include escalation steps: 1) triage -> 2) canary rollback -> 3) customer SMS/Slack template.
Asha: Good. Keep comments inline in the doc. For feedback capture during QBR, we'll use the short form at the top of the doc and synthesize into follow-ups.
Liam: Any objections to including a small risk matrix slide (Impact x Likelihood) with SSO as highest? I think clarity helps execs.
Jenna: Agree. Visual risk matrix will help.
Asha: No objections. Final ask — everyone mark done in the owners doc when complete. I'll compile slides Thu night and send invites for Fri 11am PT dry run.
Ravi: Noted. Posting PR link when ready.
Olivia: I'll leave comments where I add checklist items.
Jenna: Thanks team — will confirm attendees in 2hrs.
Asha: :rocket: Thanks all, let's keep this tight.
qbr-bot: Reminder scheduled: dry-run Fri 11:00 PT (invites pending)
